fields.Name: T145 - MCP Tool Favorites Filter
fields.Description: Tests the per-tool favorite persistence (toggleFavorite/isFavorited via user settings) combined with the favoritesOnly filter predicate — a bespoke favorite-and-filter code path unique to the tools tab.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT Ctrl+K), open the MCP section, then go to the Tools tab. If any tools are shown, click a tool's star (favorite) icon and confirm it fills in to indicate the tool is now favorited. Then open the Filter popover (the filter button in the toolbar) and set the 'Favorites' filter to 'Favorites only', and confirm the tools list responds — narrowing to favorited tools OR showing a clear empty state. Success is that the favorite star toggles AND the favorites-only filter changes the displayed set (or yields a valid empty state); if no tools exist at all, a 'No tools discovered yet' empty state is acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a tool's star icon visibly toggles its favorited state (filled vs. outline star), OR no tools exist and a valid empty state is shown
The Filter popover offers a Favorites ('Favorites only') option that, when applied, narrows the tool list or shows a clear no-match/empty state
The active filter count / applied-filter indicator reflects the favorites filter being on
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
